about: New York Personal Injury Attorney Christopher J. Donadio is a partner with Gair, Gair, Conason, Rubinowitz, Bloom, Hershenhorn, Steigman & Mackauf law firm. Nationally recognized as one of the top trial lawyers in his region, Mr. Donadio provides unmatched advocacy and support to clients throughout New York and New Jersey who have suffered serious injuries or losses as a result of medical malpractice or some other tragedy caused by someone else's negligence.

Over the course of his practice spanning more than 13 years, Mr. Donadio has secured millions of dollars in total compensation for individuals and families in need. Among his most notable successes, he secured a verdict of more than $6.25 million for an injured construction worker and a $3 million verdict for a medical malpractice victim.

He has also obtained several multimillion-dollar settlements for his plaintiff clients, including a $5.85 million dollar settlement for an injured construction worker and a $3.5 million settlement for a child significantly harmed as the result of a failed diagnosis.

Honored for his outstanding professionalism and service, Mr. Donadio has earned a Top 40 Under 40 ranking from The National Trial Lawyers, as well as designation as one of New York's Leading Personal Injury Lawyers from Leaders in the Law. He has also received consistent recognition from The Best Lawyers in America along with many other top rankings and endorsements from his peers. He has also received numerous testimonials and referrals from his satisfied clients.

A 2004 graduate of Boston College, Mr. Donadio obtained his Juris Doctor from Duke Law School in 2007. He is admitted to practice in New York and New Jersey as well as before the U.S. District Court for the District of New Jersey, the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York, and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 2nd Circuit.

Mr. Donadio is an active member of the New York State Trial Lawyers Association, the New Jersey Association for Justice, the American Association for Justice and the American Board of Trial Advocates, among his other professional affiliations. He also conducts lectures and seminars before various legal organizations on a variety of legal topics.
